description: Fetches recently resolved prediction markets from Polymarket and Manifold over the last N days (max 30). Includes question, winning outcome, final prices/probabilities, resolution timestamp, and resolution source. Optional keyword filter. Information only, not financial advice. Related tools on this server, for a different need: pm_search when you need to search open prediction markets on Polymarket and Manifold; pm_activity when you need to fetch recent trading and on-chain lifecycle activity. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: pm_resolved
title: Fetches recently resolved prediction markets
